description: This PHP class 'EntityAliasMapping' defines two constant associative arrays mapping entity-related string keys (aliases) to their corresponding database fields and their dependencies within an HR management system. It provides a central reference for alias-to-field mapping and dependency resolution in reporting or data retrieval.

classes.name: EntityAliasMapping
classes.description: A final class containing constant mappings for entity alias to database fields and dependency relationships used within the HRM reporting module.

methods.name: None (constants only)
methods.description: Contains only class constants, no methods defined.
